name: belote-online
description: Belote Royale — online & offline belote card game (web + PWA + mobile)

scripts.mobile:init: npm i -D @capacitor/cli@6 @capacitor/core@6 @capacitor/android@6 && npm run build && npx cap add android
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:apk: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
